name: Contradictory condition
description: Flags a compound && condition whose clauses on the same identifier cannot all be true.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, an impossible pair of clauses under `&&` on the same local or property identifier with constant numeric thresholds (e.g. `x > 10 && x < 5`, `x == 1 && x == 2`). Only direct relational comparisons (`==`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`) against a numeric literal are checked; calls, aliases, `||` chains, and mixed identifiers are left unflagged rather than guessed at.
